name: Almendros (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Almendros (a cross of Saint James, the letter M and almond trees on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Almendros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Almendros arms — cross of Saint James, letter M and almond trees
